title: P1: expose active Outcome and traffic-light lifecycle state
outOfScope: Manufacturing a completed Outcome before Finish.
Changing unrelated hosted workflow scheduling or publishing a release.

sources.reason: Defines the required active lifecycle projection and failure modes.
Creates authoritative blocked and completed Outcomes.

riskAssessment.reason: The status and Outcome generation boundaries are inspected; changes are limited to their authoritative projection.

reasons: Lifecycle status, generated documentation, and regression surfaces require strict verification.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized automatic execution of the complete remediation plan; this Contract records that authority.

preReviewWarnings: Reject stale, cross-task, or contradictory active Outcome projections.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Generated active status always declares Outcome presence or absence, human color, current or last gate, and a recovery or next action.
No-Outcome/in-progress projects yellow without manufacturing a completed Outcome.
Blocked and completed active Outcomes project red and green respectively only when bound to the active Work Item.
Stale, cross-task, malformed, or contradictory Outcomes fail closed.
Generated Status explicitly declares governance-review and Work-Item-lifecycle signal domains so their independently derived colors cannot be misread as one fact.

A Contract amendment cannot leave stale active verification evidence that forces an otherwise-valid Finish retry; Finish discards evidence bound to a different Contract hash before recording the current run.
Regression tests cover no Outcome, in-progress, blocked, completed, and cross-task Outcome cases.
Operator documentation describes the traffic-light semantics and recovery boundary.
guidelines: Generated status is authoritative and must not be hand-edited.
Outcome facts must be task-bound and fail closed on contradictions.
Public lifecycle semantics must be documented.

intent.problem: Operators cannot determine whether an active Work Item has emitted an Outcome or what its lifecycle state is while Finish is running.
constraints: Derive facts only from Contract, Summary, and task-bound Outcome evidence.
Do not manufacture a completed Outcome before Finish.
Preserve fail-closed handling of stale or cross-task evidence.
intent.rationale: A single generated projection gives operators visible red/yellow/green state without weakening lifecycle evidence.
